name: modelapp
description: Model App Protocol (MAP): one typed object — defineApp({ entities, actions, pages, fragments, agents, … }) — becomes a JSON manifest for workspace hosts and a plain, conformant MCP server (tools, annotations, MCP Apps views) for ChatGPT, Claude and any MCP client. Also: Next.js route handlers and rewrites (modelapp/next), a Node server (modelapp/node), a test client (modelapp/testing), the conformance checks (modelapp/spec) and the `modelapp check` CLI. Spec: docs/map/spec.md.
